text:
carmen: Quick sync — trying to land concrete launch thresholds for the long-horizon routing + multi-region / multi-tenant isolation roadmap. Need gating criteria and customer signals we can point to. TL;DR: what metrics + counts let us move from canary -> GA? cc @raj @olivia @liam

raj: My proposal: p95 latency SLO 99.9% <= 200ms for hosted tier, 99.5% for Dedicated; route-level error rate < 0.1%. These are the acceptance numbers ops can measure.

olivia: +1 on p95. Also insist on cross-region failover time < 1s (time to first successful response via fallback). Need tail latency breakdown by tenant/region in telemetry.

liam: Sales perspective: we'll need either two paying customers running >10k req/day in prod OR five customers in beta across multiple regions. Also customers will push hard on data residency guarantees — call that out.

tomas: Operational gating: during canary keep incident rate <= 1/week for canary tenants, MTTR (mean time to mitigation) < 30m, and SLO burn < 5% over any 24h window. If we exceed, we stop the rollout.

sophie: From CS: define explicit rollback triggers — e.g. customer-facing errors > 0.5% sustained for 1 hour => automatic rollback + manual outreach. Add an opt-out flag per customer.

olivia: Also add a quality/regression guardrail: run a small eval harness (customer prompt set + semantic checks). Block if semantic QA delta > 3% vs baseline.

raj: Feature gating idea: canary in 2 regions first, mixed-models for resilience (quantized + fp16 variants) to exercise fallbacks. Routing_policy for canary = prefer-local -> regional-pool -> global-fallback.

carmen: Good. Can we turn this into an itemized launch checklist? I'll draft. Anyone want to add MUST-haves that block canary start?

liam: Legal asks: KMS/HSM integration sign-off for Private/EU customers. Add that as a MUST for Private deployments.

tomas: Add a chaos engineering test: simulate AZ / node loss during canary and validate failover completes without increasing customer errors.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: started to region eu-west for tenant-set "beta-3" at 1763141700

raj: Cost constraint: unit cost delta vs baseline must be <= 1.5x for GA or we need an approved cost cap per token per customer class. Otherwise Finance will push back.

carmen: Recap for my checklist: SLA targets (p95), error thresholds, incident MTTR, customer count thresholds, KMS/legal signoff, cost cap, eval/regression gate, chaos test. Anything missing?

sophie: Observability requirement: token-level cost + per-route latency dashboards available to beta customers + internal runbooks surfaced.

olivia: Docs requirement: fallback taxonomy (model variants, quantization compatibility), explicit region routing table, and guidance for customers to pin model versions.

liam: I'll line up two customers for early prod (names tentative: @acme-prod, @fintech-squad). Both want HIPAA/HIPAA-like guidance — add compliance note.

carmen: Perfect. I'll assemble a PR with the checklist + gating matrix and share for review. Expect a draft in the next 24h. :white_check_mark:
